message.zh: 修复后台挂机战斗消息堆积及多处内存持续增长，限制 DPS 历史、玩家缓存和采集数据，清理旧存储。建议更新到 26.4.23，并刷新所有已打开的游戏标签页。
message.en: Fixes background combat message backlogs and several causes of growing memory use. Bounds DPS history, player caches and captures, and cleans up legacy storage. Update to 26.4.23 and refresh all open game tabs.
